title: Study of Multiple Ascending Doses (MAD) of M5542 in Participants With Moderate and Severe Eczema
official: A Phase 1b, Open Label Study Without Comparator to Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability, and Pharmacokinetics of Multiple Ascending Doses (MAD) of M5542 in Patients With Eczema
summary: The main purpose of this study is to evaluate the safety and tolerability of multiple ascending dose (MAD) of M5542 in participants with Eczema.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Confirmed diagnosis of eczema with an onset of symptoms at least 6 months prior to Screening
* Topical treatments provide inadequate control for at least 4 consecutive weeks within 1 year of the first dose, or documented reason why they were medically inadvisable (for example \[e.g.\] important side effects or safety risks)
* Other protocol defined inclusion criteria could apply

Exclusion Criteria:

* Any uncontrolled medical conditions, other than eczema that in the opinion of the Investigator, put the participant at unacceptable risk, or will likely interfere with study assessments or data integrity. Other medical conditions should be stable at the time of Screening and be expected to remain stable for the duration of the study
* Other than eczema, the presence of a significant skin morbidity that will influence the Investigator's ability to assess the diagnosis of eczema and/or severity of disease (for example (e.g.) psoriasis, confirmed or suspected cutaneous T cell lymphoma, autoimmune bullous disease, fixed drug reaction, and Stevens Johnson Syndrome, other)
* History of malignancies, or current malignancies (except for fully resected non melanoma skin cancer, and in situ cervical carcinoma) within the past 5 years
* Known history of, or suspected, significant current or any past history of tuberculosis or non tuberculous mycobacterial infections (including a positive QuantiFERON® Tuberculosis Gold blood test within 4 weeks prior to or at the time of Screening)
* Other protocol defined exclusion criteria could apply
